headlines.title: Here's Why a Hold Strategy Is Apt for Southern Company Stock Now
headlines.summary: SO benefits from strong power demand, OpenAI's long-term contract and regulated growth prospects, while high capital needs, rising debt costs and weak returns remain concerns.

headlines.title: Southern Co (SO) Cleared PSC Review for 3.2GW of OpenAI Demand. Can Data Centers Lower Customer Bills Without Raising Grid Risk?
headlines.summary: The Southern Company (NYSE:SO) cleared the Georgia Public Service Commission review process for Georgia Power to serve an OpenAI data center project in Effingham County, Georgia. The 25-year agreement covers approximately 3.2 gigawatts of new demand.

headlines.title: Is Southern Company Stock Underperforming the Dow?
headlines.summary: Southern Company has underperformed the Dow over the past year, and analysts are cautious about the stock’s prospects.

headlines.title: How Much Does a 61-Year-Old Need Invested to Collect $8,600 a Month for Life?
headlines.summary: Building a retirement income sleeve around seven funds sounds like diversification, but the largest position in this blueprint has a quiet habit of inflating its own payout once a year without ever promising to repeat it.

headlines.title: NEE Stock Trades at a Premium Valuation: Buy, Hold or Stay Away?
headlines.summary: NextEra Energy's renewable backlog, Florida demand and earnings growth support steady performance, but its premium valuation may warrant patience.

description: The Southern Company, through its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of electricity. The company offers electric service to retail customers and wholesale customers; and energy-related products and services to natural gas choice markets. It also develops, constructs, acquires, owns, operates, and manages power generation assets, as well as battery energy storage projects; sells electricity at market-based rates in the wholesale market; and deploys microgrids for commercial, industrial, governmental, and utility customers. In addition, the company is involved in the distribution of natural gas in Illinois, Georgia, Virginia, and Tennessee; distributes energy and resilience solutions; and invests in telecommunications. The Southern Company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
